11-2C-1. - Purpose.
","ShouldShowMiniToc":false,"Id":"TIT11UNDECO_CH2DIRE_ARTCINDI_11-2C-1PU","Title":"11-2C-1. - Purpose.","Content":"
\n

\n A.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Light industrial district (I-L). The purpose of the I-L district is to provide for convenient employment centers of\n light manufacturing, research and development, warehousing, and distributing. In accord\n with the Meridian Comprehensive Plan, the I-L district is intended to encourage the\n development of industrial uses that are clean, quiet and free of hazardous or objectionable\n elements and that are operated, entirely, or almost entirely, within enclosed structures.\n Accessibility to transportation systems is a requirement of this district.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n B.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n Heavy industrial district (I-H). The purpose of the I-H district is to provide for the existing manufacturing, warehousing\n and heavy distribution centers that exist along major transportation corridors. In\n accord with the Meridian Comprehensive Plan, these areas require buffering from residential\n uses to mitigate the effects of noise, vibration, traffic, odor, dust, smoke or glare\n that is typically associated with the uses allowed in the I-H district. Accessibility\n to transportation systems is a requirement of this district.\n

\n \t\t\n

\n (Ord. 05-1170, 8-30-2005, eff. 9-15-2005)\n
